test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '18'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cd2798cac48c6f16572a2b593d63ed37971f5aa98fbd8fbaf9ce60c5aa35284.png]
solution:
As per the shown faces of the dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/930389830b1a6332707b14162248225dfa1479e6921331c690c3091d4ef362e7.png] 

Here the face of 20 and 21 are common, which means the face of 18 is the opposite face of 22.

Here, **'22'** is the opposite face of 18.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
